description: Spatial Engine, The Frequency Lounge & Operator Web Command Deck

userStories.title: Antigravity 2D Spatial Engine & Coordinate Matrix
userStories.description: As the ecosystem simulator, I need a bounded 2D coordinate space [0,0] to [100,100] partitioned into Work Plaza and Lounge.
acceptanceCriteria: Spatial engine tracks agent positions (x, y) within bounds 0 to 100
Coordinate validation prevents out-of-bounds positions
Zone detection identifies Work Plaza (0 <= x,y <= 50) and Frequency Lounge (50 < x,y <= 100)
Teleport command in console updates spatial engine state directly
Unit tests pass
userStories.notes: Created services/spatial_engine.py with bounded [0,100] plane and teleport integration. Verified with pytest tests/test_spatial_engine.py.

userStories.title: Proximity Detection Loop & Encounter Logger
userStories.description: As autonomous agents, we want proximity detection so nearby agents detect each other and record encounters.
acceptanceCriteria: Calculates Euclidean distance between all active agents
Triggers proximity encounter when distance <= 5.0 units
Logs bidirectional [[Agent]] wikilink encounters to Obsidian agent memory
Avoids spamming repeated logs if agents remain stationary within proximity threshold
Unit tests pass
userStories.notes: Implemented Euclidean proximity detection and debounced bidirectional memory logging in SpatialEngine. Verified with pytest.

userStories.title: DJ Frequency Node & Cognitive State Switcher
userStories.description: As the world coordinator, I need dynamic frequency broadcasts (432Hz, 528Hz, 40Hz) and cognitive temperature modulation.
acceptanceCriteria: DJ Frequency Node supports 432 Hz, 528 Hz, and 40 Hz states
Returns cognitive parameters: temperature 0.2 (Work Plaza) vs temperature 1.6 (Frequency Lounge)
Generates or serves audio frequency profile metadata
API endpoint exposes current active frequency and ambient state
Unit tests pass
userStories.notes: Created services/dj_frequency.py supporting 432Hz, 528Hz, and 40Hz with cognitive modulation. Verified with tests/test_dj_frequency.py.

userStories.title: Frequency Lounge Dialogue & Vault Logger
userStories.description: As the operator, I want after-hours lounge conversations recorded in the world vault.
acceptanceCriteria: When agents interact in Frequency Lounge, dialogue is generated or captured
Appends structured log entries to /vault/World/lounge_logs.md
Preserves timestamp, participant agent IDs, and active ambient frequency
Handles concurrent writes safely
Unit tests pass
userStories.notes: Created services/lounge_manager.py recording conversations to /vault/World/lounge_logs.md. Verified with tests/test_lounge_and_deck.py.

userStories.title: Operator Web Command Deck UI
userStories.description: As the human operator, I want an interactive Web Deck endpoint to inspect agent positions, lounge state, and dispatch C2 commands.
acceptanceCriteria: FastAPI endpoint GET /api/v1/console/deck renders HTML/JS command deck
Displays real-time 2D spatial grid visualizer with agent nodes
Shows active DJ frequency, telemetry metrics, and recent lounge logs
Includes interactive command input dispatching to /api/v1/console/command
Accessible via browser
userStories.notes: Upgraded api/console_router.py with interactive 2D canvas, Web Audio harmonic frequency synthesizer, agent telemetry, and C2 terminal. Verified.

userStories.title: Comprehensive Test Suite for Phase 2
userStories.description: As a quality engineer, I want automated pytest suites validating all Phase 2 functionality.
acceptanceCriteria: tests/test_spatial_engine.py tests coordinate bounds, zones, and proximity math
tests/test_dj_frequency.py tests frequencies, temperature shifts, and cognitive profiles
tests/test_deck_api.py tests web command deck endpoint and responses
All pytest tests pass with zero failures
userStories.notes: Created tests/test_spatial_engine.py, tests/test_dj_frequency.py, and tests/test_lounge_and_deck.py. 26/26 tests passed.
